about: ClipSkill table for the 30 expansion skills (A1-D8), written by the lab-flipbooks agent 06/11/2026 for docs/work/tasks/lab-castable-skills.md (fields of section 1). Gameplay lines from Gemini (docs/games/tu-tien/source/gemini-skills-expansion-2026-11-05.md); strike times measured on the real clips in art-src/lab/vfx/expansion/.

arena.source: docs/games/tu-tien/skills/SKILL_REACH.md:92 (Thanh Thach Ai 40 x 26 m, centre (0;0)); a field shape of r 22 m from the centre covers every corner (half diagonal 23.9 m)

how.clips: Each expansion clip is the Firefly image-to-video of a still, 5 s, already at near full strength at frame 0: energy stays within about 20-40 % of its maximum for the whole clip, so the clip has no sharp "impact frame". tOnset is when the smoothed energy first reaches 90 % of its early maximum (first 2.5 s); when that is under 0.15 s (the clip starts at strength) strikes[0].t falls back to the Gemini snap time (0.15-0.4 s).
how.strikes: strikes[0] is the main hit (power 1 or the strongest of the opening waves); later hits and ticks are offsets after it taken from the Gemini text (waves, strike counts, dot durations). kind "hit" = a damage event with the reaction and hit-stop of its tier; "tick" = a light dot damage with no hit-stop. power is relative within the skill (1 = the main hit).
how.count: points per wave (7 lances, 16 handprints...), not waves; waves are the entries of strikes.
how.mark: seconds of ground mark before the first hit for skills that fall from the sky or land on a point (lesson 1 of skills/REF_VIDEO_LESSONS_2026-11-05.md); null = none.
how.linger: seconds of aftermath, from the decay time in the Gemini text (1.5-2.0 s here).
how.sfx: one wav of tt-sfx-x-<id> (takes 1-4, 6 s each), picked by a heuristic on onset, peak and tail, not by ear; null where Firefly sound ran out (D6, D7, D8).
how.guess: Every entry lists in guess[] the fields that are not measured or stated: shape, radius, count, damage, status, mark, linger and the later strikes are design decisions from the Gemini text and the arena size, not data.
